sentence: This project studies how mechanical signals affect cellular functions, including cell mechanics and drug delivery.
This project builds a learning environment that combines physical and virtual parts so emergency responders can learn to work with powered exoskeletons.
This project builds methods that find faults in robotic and autonomous systems by studying their code and the real-world data they meet.
This project builds a computer model of how the brain helps rats find their way in very large spaces with landmarks and moving obstacles.
This project builds a program that teaches how to secure artificial intelligence systems and use artificial intelligence to strengthen cybersecurity.
This project studies whether the same molecular pathways changed again and again as ground beetles adapted to alpine environments.
This project studies how catalysts change while they turn carbon dioxide into chemicals and fuels.
This project builds machine learning methods that find mathematical models from data on how viruses spread in insect pests of forests.
This project develops control and sensing methods for autonomous vehicles.
This project develops a rubber that changes its optical properties when squeezed or stretched, so robots can see the forces they feel.
This project carries out hands-on research on nanoscale science and engineering topics such as flexible electronics, nanomotors and batteries.
This project develops ways to build a transistor that acts as both memory and a computing device into standard electronic circuits.
This project builds vision sensors and processors inspired by the retina and the visual cortex to make computer vision use less energy.
This project uses computer simulations to predict how red blood cells, neutrophils and tumor cells squeeze through pores between endothelial cells.
This project runs a data archive and computing center that stores and processes sky observations of gamma rays from a mountain observatory.
This project studies the timing of leaf color change and leaf fall in autumn trees by combining data from two long-term studies.
